p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u006/system/state/workspace/programs/task-59e82967.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            color = row[c - 1]
            if color != background and row[c] == background and row[c + 1] == color and color < 9:
                out[r][c] = color + 1
    return out
'''

exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'))

for r,cs in [(4,[5,7]),(10,[9])]:
    for c in cs: demo_expected[r][c]=2
assert transform(demo_in)==demo_expected
